info.title: Bouncify Universal API
info.description: Verify individual emails, upload and manage Bouncify bulk verification jobs, and download bulk verification results.

get.description: Retrieves bulk email list job status from Bouncify.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: jobId
parameters.description: Bulk verification job id to inspect.

schema.description: Bulk verification job id to inspect.

commonIsp.description: Count of common ISP emails in the batch.

disposable.description: Count of disposable emails in the batch.

roleBased.description: Count of role-based emails in the batch.

spamtrap.description: Count of spamtrap emails in the batch.

syntaxError.description: Count of syntax-error emails in the batch.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the job was created.

message.description: Provider message describing the status result.

pending.description: Number of pending emails when present.

acceptAll.description: Count of accept-all results when present.

deliverable.description: Count of deliverable results when present.

undeliverable.description: Count of undeliverable results when present.

unknown.description: Count of unknown results when present.

status.description: Current Bouncify status for the bulk job.

total.description: Total number of emails in the bulk job.

verified.description: Number of verified emails when present.
